caseName: Bear Valley Mut. Water Co. v. Jewell
caseNameFull: BEAR VALLEY MUTUAL WATER COMPANY v. Sally JEWELL, Secretary of the Interior

opinions.text: Motion of Pacific Legal Foundation for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Association of California Water Agencies, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.
